title: Definite objects
summary: Mark a particular object with the accusative `-(n)Y` (*çaýy*, *almany*), soften *k*, *p*, *ç* before a vowel (*kitaby*, *çöregi*, *agajy*), use the pronouns as objects (*meni*, *ony*, *muny*) and put objects in the natural order.
canDo: Say what you see, buy, eat or drink, in general or a particular one
Spell words whose last consonant changes before an ending
Say who you know, like, invite or listen to
Buy food at the market and ask a price
